summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Matthew Jon Leone, the bassist of the rock band Madina Lake. It gives his birth date and notes that he is an identical twin of Nathan Leone, the band's lead vocalist, being three minutes older.
one_line: Matthew Jon Leone is the bassist of rock band Madina Lake and identical twin of vocalist Nathan Leone.
key_facts: Matthew Jon Leone is the bassist of the rock band Madina Lake.
Matthew Jon Leone was born on May 31, 1975.
Matthew Jon Leone is three minutes older than his identical twin Nathan Leone.
Nathan Leone is the lead vocalist in the rock band Madina Lake.
Matthew Jon Leone and Nathan Leone are identical twins.
